messages.subject: Planning multiple output feature
parts:
Hi,
I would like to share a plan concerning this advanced feature. The idea is to generate two outputs with the same mapreduce job. It is completely possible to achieve the same results with multiple jobs now. This feature is only intended to save compute time. I think the main question is that if this is a feature waiting for a use case, and if any of rmr's users are so far ahead as to need this. I had one beautiful use case, stochastic SVD, but it requires a more advanced feature that can not be accessed from streaming, so it's out of reach for no (we can still implement the same algorithm, just with one or two additional jobs). So my plan is to let this sit for some time and see if any users have use cases for this feature or opinions about the proposed API. The implementation will be non-trivial, as we are trying to put some distance between the R API and the streaming API where algorithm logic is commingled with IO format issues, something we'd like to avoid in rmr. Thanks


Antonio
